categories.main_business_segments: Seetel New Energy primarily operates in energy storage services, including turnkey engineering construction and operation & maintenance of energy storage sites. It also provides frequency regulation ancillary services (AFC) such as dynamic regulation reserve (dReg) and enhancement dynamic regulation reserve (E-dReg), energy integration management services, and manufacturing of energy storage battery cabinets through its subsidiary. The company offers energy management system (EMS) solutions integrating AI, BIM, and big data analytics for optimized energy dispatch and virtual power plant development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary EMS cloud platform technology combined with Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) for energy forecasting, load balancing, and power quality event recognition. It integrates battery modules, battery management systems (BMS), and power conversion systems (PCS) in its energy storage solutions. Manufacturing includes localized production of 2MWh energy storage cabinets with certifications such as VPC, and the company employs AI-driven predictive maintenance and remote monitoring for operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Seetel serves primarily the renewable energy sector, including utility-scale energy storage projects and industrial/commercial clients requiring grid ancillary services. Key customers include Taiwan Power Company (Taipower) for participation in its power trading platform and various project owners for turnkey energy storage system construction and maintenance. The company also collaborates with battery module developers and energy system integrators.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations are concentrated in Taiwan, with headquarters in Taipei and manufacturing facilities in Taichung. Its projects and services cover multiple regions within Taiwan, including demonstration sites in New Taipei, Linkou, Chiayi, Changhua, and Kaohsiung. There is no indication of overseas operations or securities listings.
categories.supply_chain_position: Seetel operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy storage supply chain. It provides integrated engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services, system integration, and operational management of energy storage sites. Through its subsidiary, it also engages in manufacturing battery modules and energy storage cabinets, positioning itself upstream in battery system production as well.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on advancing energy storage integration technologies, including AI-based demand response, renewable energy smoothing control strategies, microgrid interconnection, and virtual power plant optimization. It invests in R&D for EMS software, battery system safety, and manufacturing capabilities to enhance product quality and operational reliability. Future plans include expanding behind-the-meter energy storage applications and increasing local production capacity to support Taiwan's renewable energy transition.
categories.revenue_model: Seetel generates revenue through engineering project contracts (turnkey construction and system integration), service fees from energy storage operation and maintenance, and participation in ancillary service markets via power trading platforms. It also earns income from manufacturing and selling energy storage battery cabinets and related components. The company charges for energy management services and power trading facilitation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in Taiwan's rapidly growing and competitive energy storage market, focusing on integrated system solutions and local manufacturing. It differentiates itself through strong EPC capabilities, proprietary EMS technology, AI integration, and comprehensive O&M services. While specific competitors are not named, Seetel positions itself as a leading local player with significant project milestones and certifications, emphasizing safety, technology, and value.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Seetel experienced rapid revenue growth from NT$94 million in 2022 to NT$428 million in 2023, a 355% increase, driven by expanded project execution and manufacturing output. Despite increased operating expenses leading to a net loss of NT$12.8 million in 2023, the company significantly expanded its capital base from NT$29.7 million to NT$500 million. Asset growth and capital injections support its scaling operations, with ongoing investments in production capacity and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Seetel emphasizes technology-driven green energy solutions with a focus on safety, reliability, and integrated service delivery. Its unique value lies in combining advanced AI-enabled EMS, local manufacturing of certified energy storage systems, and comprehensive EPC plus O&M services. The company offers fast project development, regulatory compliance expertise, and innovative virtual power plant capabilities, positioning itself as a trusted partner in Taiwan's energy transition.
